chapters.text: Pick one agent and see everything about them for any period.
Open the Boss dashboard → Agent detail and choose the period at the top right.
Pick an agent from the list (or click a name in the CRM report tab).

The tiles show open leads, new leads (how many contacted, first response time), deals closed and their value, commission and the agent's share, CRM calls, dialer calls, meetings and site visits, and leads that need attention. Click a tile to open the leads or reports behind it.
Below: their leads by stage (now, and came in this period), follow-up discipline (on time, overdue, no next step, stale) and every deal they closed with its commission.
